descriptionChirho: A lying down that results in seminal emission, used in the construct שִׁכְבַת־זֶרַע 'emission of seed' in Levitical purity laws (Lev 15:16-18, 19:20, 22:4; Num 5:13). The 7 occurrences uniformly refer to the act of sexual intercourse or nocturnal emission in a ritual-purity context. Multilingual evidence: eng 'emission of / lying of,' spa 'emisión de,' hin स्खलन, arb مَضْجَعَةُ, kor 누움의, swa mbegu ya. All translations point to the biological act of seminal discharge.

A physical layer or stratum, denoting a coating or spread-out surface. Used in contexts describing a covering or deposit laid over something. Distinct from the sexual-emission sense, this refers to a tangible physical layer. Multilingual evidence confirms a separate meaning: eng 'layer of,' spa 'capa de,' hin परत, arb طَبَقَةُ, kor 층이, swa tabaka la. The Arabic طَبَقَة and Swahili tabaka both specifically denote a physical stratum, clearly diverging from the bodily-emission sense.
